scientific_question: At the same twelve fitted parameters and 13A+1A-transpose non-anchor budget as v166, can a genuinely local non-affine mass-conserving flow repair both late five-camera gradient tails?
role: result-blind, post-open controlled virtual-BOST mechanism diagnostic frozen after the independently validated v166 failure; no v167 scientific array may be read before this protocol and its complete formal and independent implementation closure are committed
physical_hypothesis: The v166 global affine velocity cannot express spatially varying flame motion. A smooth partition-of-unity velocity can move four symmetric 3D regions differently while retaining the density continuity equation, camera-permutation invariance, variable camera cardinality, and the same twelve observable-fit directions.
pre_freeze_synthetic_correction: An uncommitted trilinear prototype was rejected before any formal scientific array was read because interpolation at grid nodes was not differentiable and its zero-flow upper boundary was numerically unstable. The frozen primary instead uses C1 Catmull-Rom cubic convolution with explicit zero extension and boundary snapping, whose node derivative matches the frozen centered zero-extension continuity tangent.

representation.field_subspace: zero-mean orthonormal DCT 16x8x8 excluding the constant coefficient
representation.initial_anchor: at t=0 use the frozen isotropic H1 fixed-0.03 reconstruction because no previous deployed state exists
representation.normalized_coordinates: map each world axis affinely to [-1,1] using the frozen field bounds
representation.partition_rule: phi_r(x)=softmax_r(c_r dot s(x)) with no temperature or width parameter; the four positive weights sum exactly to one
representation.local_velocity: u(x)=h_min*sum_r phi_r(x)*v_r, with four independent three-component dimensionless vectors v_r
representation.continuity_tangents: for each region r and world axis j form -div(rho_previous*h_min*phi_r*e_j)=-h_min*(phi_r*d_j rho_previous+rho_previous*d_j phi_r), with d_j rho defined by the centered zero-extension derivative that is exactly the node derivative of the frozen Catmull-Rom sampler
representation.observation_fit: project the twelve local continuity tangents through the current reported-geometry operator and solve the current observation innovation by column-normalized minimum-norm SVD
representation.speed_cap: scale all twelve coefficients by one common factor so h_min*max_r(norm(v_r)) is at most h_min*(t_i-t_(i-1))/0.25; convex partition weights then bound pointwise speed and total stationary-flow displacement
representation.flow_integration: fixed 16-step classical RK4 over unit pseudo-time; inverse characteristics solve dX/dtau=-u(X), while log density factor solves dL/dtau=-div(u)(X)
representation.flow_roundtrip_audit: apply the same fixed RK4 forward then backward on the Cartesian 3x3x3 lattice formed by each axis minimum, midpoint, and maximum; report maximum recovery error divided by minimum grid spacing
representation.exact_density_action: sample rho_previous at the inverse-flow endpoint with tensor-product Catmull-Rom cubic convolution and explicit zero extension, snapping coordinates within 64 float64 machine eps of a closed grid boundary to that boundary, then multiply by exp(L); this is the fixed differentiable numerical push-forward for the stationary local continuity flow
representation.zero_mean_projection: after local mass-conserving transport, remove the field mean only because the frozen reconstruction subspace excludes the constant DCT coefficient
representation.current_solve: project the transported prior into the same DCT subspace and solve (G+alpha*H)c=q+alpha*H*c_transport with frozen isotropic H1 and alpha=0.03*median_positive_generalized_eigenvalue
representation.no_transport_control: the same causal centered-H1 recurrence using the previous control coefficients directly, with no local fit or flow
representation.previous_state: the immediately previous reconstruction of the same arm, model, calibration, and active-camera set; never truth or a separately selected candidate
representation.permutation_contract: camera-row reordering leaves G, q, fitted local parameters, transported prior, and reconstructed coefficients unchanged within frozen tolerances
representation.variable_cardinality: the same mechanism is rebuilt independently for fixed 5-, 7-, and 9-camera active sets
representation.forbidden_variants: no partition-temperature search, alternate vertices, affine term, passive-scalar fallback, determinant exponent, future frame, bidirectional smoothing, truth state, reset, component clipping, alternate cap, alternate SVD cutoff, alternate interpolation kernel, learned transition, alternate anchor, per-sample selector, alternate RK method or post-result multiplier

decision_order: Any input-root, parent-evidence, source-semantics, operator, basis, sequence, density, partition, local-rank, continuity-tangent, linearized-fit, speed-cap, flow, density-factor, stationarity, residual, accounting, current-control, permutation, or independent-recomputation failure makes v167 inconclusive.

Only the frozen four-region observation-fitted local continuity flow with fixed partition, cap, SVD cutoff, RK4 integrator, interpolation, and H1 multiplier 0.03 is primary; no alternative partition, width, mode, radius, step count, or multiplier may replace it after results.

The primary passes only if all twelve time-by-camera strata pass every absolute gate, every nine-camera stratum satisfies parent no-harm, and t=0.75 five-camera gradient p90 is strictly below the frozen current-run H1 value.
If the no-transport centered-H1 control also passes all twelve strata, local transport is not credited and a predictor is not authorized from this diagnostic alone.

A valid primary failure closes only this tetrahedral soft-partition stationary local continuity flow; it does not prove all local flow impossible and does not authorize partition tuning, a larger network, or GPU rescue.

A valid primary pass with no-transport-control failure establishes only controlled virtual-BOST local-continuity headroom and authorizes a separately frozen minimal CPU observation-only predictor diagnostic; it is not real BOST, external generalization, or a resource result.
